name: Uruguay
sources: GDP $9.3bn and 3.10m people (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CD and SP.POP.TOTL, 1990; exact prints $9.299bn and 3,104,403).

Inflation 1.125 means 112.5%: the INE CPI annual average for 1990, the worst Uruguayan print since 1968 and the reason Luis Alberto Lacalle's first act on taking office on 1 March 1990 was a fiscal adjustment. December-on-December was about 129%. interest_rate 1.15 means 115%, the peso lending benchmark; the real rate is roughly neutral, which is what the schema's coupling rule is checking for and what a crawling-peg regime actually produces.

Tax take 27% of GDP, the highest in this region's roster: Uruguay is the region's welfare state, with pensions alone near 10% of GDP and a 1989 plebiscite having constitutionally indexed them to wages — the single largest constraint on every government that follows.
Debt 0.55: external debt about $4.4bn at end-1990 (World Bank), some 47% of GDP; total public debt is nearer 55%. Uruguay signed its Brady agreement in February 1991.
Oil 0.00: no domestic production at all. ANCAP refines imported crude at La Teja.

Defence 2.3% of GDP and strength 2, an army sized for a country of three million between two large neighbours. Stability 65 and separatism 0.0 — the highest stability and lowest strain in this region. The dictatorship ended in March 1985, and the amnesty for the military was confirmed by referendum on 16 April 1989 with 57% voting to uphold it, which settled the transition rather than deferring it.

pop_growth_1990 = 0.5519%/yr. Compound annual growth of World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, series URY (Uruguay): 3,002,488 in 1984 to 3,086,255 in 1989 — the five years ending on the eve of the 1 January 1990 start date. See EconomyRecord::pop_growth_1990 in spheres-sim/src/data/mod.rs for why the window ends in 1989 and not with the single-year 1990 rate.

reserves_bn = 1.548 ($bn). Total reserves including gold, URY, 1989: US$1547554304.49 (World Bank World Development Indicators series FI.RES.TOTL.CD, 'Total reserves (includes gold, current US$)', retrieved from the World Bank API on 2026-09-02; indicator lastupdated 2026-07-13). THE 1989 OBSERVATION AND NOT THE 1990 ONE: a reserve is a stock, and the stock on the morning of the 1 January 1990 start date is the end-1989 figure - the same reasoning pop_growth_1990 above gives for ending its window on 31 December 1989. LIMIT STATED: this series is official reserve assets. Sovereign wealth fund balances are not in it and none has been added, because no audited 1990 balance could be sourced for any of them; where that materially understates a state's usable stock it is reported rather than estimated (iron rule 4).

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

DATA-KEYED TAIL NATION. This nation is outside the 29 authored majors, so nothing here was authored technology by technology: a grant is made only where one of two named published global series supports it, and nothing is modelled, estimated or interpolated. A short list, or an empty one, is the correct outcome of that rule and not a gap in the work.

Data-keyed tail nation: not one of the 29 authored majors. Only the two series named in ruling 3 were consulted - WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 1990 and World Bank IT.CEL.SETS. Nothing was modelled, estimated or interpolated, and no other evidence was admitted. ISO3 key used for both series: URY.
WUENIC DTP3 1990 = 97% against the 80% UCI-1990 threshold: bio_universal_immunisation GRANTED.
IT.CEL.SETS at 31 December 1989 = 0 against a threshold of any positive count: refused.

The other 46 grantable 1990 technologies are BLANK for this nation by design, not by oversight: the 17 sovereignty-side entries are unreachable by any use-in-operation series, and no published global series was named that keys the remaining 29 use-side entries.
